lines.zh: 我迈步的节奏是一样的。
lines.en: My marching rhythm never varies.
I'm lime green, like a new leaf.
I step out of the rank.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上嗑出小坑。
lines.en: My feet tap small hollows in the ground.
I walk toward the far end of the yard.
I walk in a dead straight line.
I lift my knee high.

lines.zh: 我经过的时候尘土飞起来。
lines.en: Dust rises as I pass.
I pass between the two ranks.
I walk along the vegetable rows.
I stand with my arms at my sides.

lines.zh: 我的黄绿色被太阳晒得发亮。
lines.en: The sun brightens my lime green.
Fine cracks run over me.
I'm waiting for the flag to move.

lines.zh: 我的手指关节一节节排着。
lines.en: My knuckles line up in a row.
I stare blankly at the wall.
Wind passes through my joints.
I slowly loosen my grip.
I stand straight, shoulders still.
I've counted you as one person.
I square my head at you.
You carry no banner.
I'm waiting for that one word.
You advance; so do I.

lines.zh: 你看我这身颜色，很奇怪吧。
lines.en: My colour must look strange to you.
The sword on my back is still sheathed.
I've noted your position.
Don't cross this line.
What are you holding?
I keep count of every step.
A chunk falls off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下在我胸口开了道缝。
lines.en: That opens a seam on my chest.
I back off and hold my ground.
My sword nearly leaves my hand.
A new dent appears on me.
I stare at that crack.
I straighten up by degrees.
I make not a single sound.
Ash has mixed into my colour.
Even like this I can stand.
Dye is fine; nothing else.
I know that bottle in your hand.
Pour it over me.
The colour changes; I'm still me.
That thing you're holding won't do.
Put it down and don't touch me.
Ask my owner first.

lines.zh: 那点绿染料，是要给我换身衣服？
lines.en: That bit of green dye, is it a new coat for me?

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，泥掉了一角。
lines.en: You hit me and a corner of clay falls.
I'm shoved half a step.
I plant myself and don't move.
I straighten my crooked pauldron.
My shoulder dents a little.
I bend and pick up the fallen clay.
A cloud of dust kicks up.
I file back into the rank.
You're light; I'm planted solid.
I take it on my raised blade.
She stands beside me.

lines.zh: 我们两个人的步子一样。
lines.en: Our steps match exactly.
She puts her sword behind her.
We stand shoulder to shoulder.
She has fewer cracks than I do.

lines.zh: 我们一起看向院子门口。
lines.en: We both look at the gate.

lines.zh: 没人的时候我们也不动。
lines.en: With no one about, we still don't move.
We're a pair, that's all.
It's dark, and we're still here.
I bend for it; my arm is too stiff.
I hold it between both palms.
My fingers leave a print in it.
I set it by my feet.
I shouldn't touch this.

lines.zh: 我把它交到主人的手里。
lines.en: I put it into my owner's hand.
It rolls away, twice around.
I kick it back where it was.
I carry sword in one hand and it in the other.
I've counted you among the enemies.
My sword leaves its sheath.
The whole row turns at once.
I begin my approach, step by step.
Not one of us shouts.
I'll hold this first strike.
I bend my knees.
We form a wall.
You're circled.
We hold this ground.

lines.zh: 我把剑锋对着你的胸口。
lines.en: I point the edge at your chest.
I raise my arm.
I've worked out where this blade lands.
I press in step by step.
The one on the left comes too.
You're in the middle of the yard.
My blade stays aimed at you.
I wait, standing steady.
One step back from you, two from us.
We close into a ring.
I know what you're going for.
I drop the point an inch.
The ones behind have gone around.
You've backed as far as you can.
I've measured this distance.
My hand is already raised.
I cut at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的甲上留了一道白线。
lines.en: A white line stays on your armor.
I strike twice in a row.
You block; I pull the blade back.
We press in together.
That lands behind your knee.
I'm shoved back three paces.
I glance at my edge.
I lunge in again.
My wrist splits open.
That swing connected.
You retreat; we follow.
I put everything into this swing.
Clay falls off me; I don't stop.
You're down; we surround you.

lines.zh: 一摊黄绿的泥落到地上。
lines.en: A puddle of lime clay lands.
Hands form first, then legs.
I'm not dry yet.
I look up at my own troop.

lines.zh: 我把剑握在手里试了试。
lines.en: I test the sword in my hand.
I find my place in the rank.
I square my stance properly.

lines.zh: 身边的人一看就是同一批。
lines.en: The ones beside me are plainly the same batch.
My sword is still caked with dirt.
I wait for the first command.
I pull my shoulders back.
The wind dries the clay further.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的边角就卷起来。
lines.en: Fire curls my edges.
Half a leg snaps off in the fall.
Water softens my shape away.
It blows half my shoulder off.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的脖子。
lines.en: Something sharp lodges in my neck.
The light loosens my clay.
I don't eat, and I can dry and crack.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我从中间裂开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I split down the middle.
